3. STRAIT OF HORMUZ — ONE GENUINE NEW UKMTO WARNING.
UKMTO WARNING 143-26, issued 29 September 2026, supersedes 142-26 of 23 September. A vessel was struck by a suspected unknown projectile while transiting the Strait of Hormuz on Monday evening (28 September); fire extinguished, vessel underway, crew safe, no environmental impact, damage not assessed. UKMTO attributes it to a delayed third-party report and does NOT attribute it to Iran, the IRGC, a missile or a mine. No CENTCOM statement located. No approved source has any IRGC missile or mine attack. Any claim of an IRGC attack on any of the disputed days remains unsupported.
